tasks.title: Test config types (HostKind, FetchSettings, HostConfig)
tasks.description: Unit tests for new config types: HostKind serde round-trip, FetchSettings default values, HostConfig TOML deserialization with all field combinations. Done when: cargo test passes, covers happy path + edge cases.

tasks.title: Add Registration, Preset, Capabilities, ProviderConfig
tasks.description: Add provider registration types to actup-core: Preset (host, api_base, token_env), Capabilities (supports_graphql/rest), ProviderConfig (resolved host config), Registration (kind, presets, inference fn, create fn). Done when: types compile with no provider crate deps.

tasks.title: Test registration types
tasks.description: Unit tests for Registration, Preset, Capabilities structs. Test Preset construction, Capabilities combinations, mock Registration with infer_api_base fn. Done when: tests pass, struct construction verified.

tasks.title: Wire new fields into Config struct
tasks.description: Replace old providers field in Config with: default_host (Option<String>), fetch (FetchSettings), hosts (HashMap<String, HostConfig>). Done when: Config compiles, old Providers removed.

tasks.description: Export static REGISTRATION from actup-provider-github with github.com preset, GITHUB_TOKEN default, GHE api_base inference (https://{host}/api/v3), graphql+rest capabilities. Done when: const compiles, preset present.

tasks.title: Test GitHub REGISTRATION
tasks.description: Unit tests for GitHub provider registration: preset values correct, infer_api_base returns correct URLs for github.com vs GHE hosts, capabilities flags set. Done when: tests verify preset + inference behavior.

tasks.title: Implement validation (hostname, URL, post-merge)
tasks.description: Hostname: lowercase, no scheme/path/port/whitespace. api_base: scheme required, path allowed, no query/fragment, strip trailing /. Post-merge: kind, api_base, token_env required. Done when: validation rejects invalid, accepts valid per spec.

tasks.title: Test validation rules
tasks.description: Comprehensive tests for validation: hostname rejects https://, ports, uppercase, whitespace; api_base requires scheme, strips trailing /; post-merge catches missing required fields. Done when: test per validation rule in spec.

tasks.title: Implement resolution logic (effective_host)
tasks.description: Implement effective_host(hostname) per spec algorithm: preset -> user override -> kind validation -> registration lookup -> defaults/inference -> required field validation -> api_mode capability check. Done when: tests cover all branches.

tasks.title: Test resolution logic
tasks.description: Tests for effective_host: preset-only host, user override of preset, non-preset with kind, inference fallbacks, error cases (missing kind, unavailable provider, invalid api_mode). Done when: all 7 algorithm steps have test coverage.
